SCEN.name: Credential compromise of administrator accounts through phishing and MFA fatigue
SCEN.statement: A financially motivated external actor phishes administrators, obtains approval of an MFA push prompt and gains remote access to core systems, enabling unauthorized access to sensitive records and follow-on intrusion.
SCEN.stakeholders: Administrators; CIO; Cybersecurity lead; Privacy officer; business owners.
SCEN.background: Remote access relies on push MFA (E2).
SCEN.threat_event: Credential phishing and MFA push fatigue.
vulns: Push MFA without phishing resistance (E2 - validate)
SCEN.assets: Identity and remote access; core records system.
SCEN.narrative: Short narrative of how the scenario unfolds.
SCEN.cvss_note: Representative weakness: single-channel push MFA. Explain every metric.

INITIATIVES: FIDO2 for privileged and remote accounts; number matching; conditional access.
KRIS: % privileged and remote-access accounts on phishing-resistant MFA
